ilfa.name: Ilfa
ilfa.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel, Rabbi Yoḥanan’s fellow student, who went off to trade while Rabbi Yoḥanan stayed to study (Ta’anit 21a).
ilfa.prompt: A sage in his 40s with a trimmed dark beard and a weathered merchant’s travelling cloak over a scholar’s robe, gripping a ship’s rope with a steady, confident gaze; background of a sunlit harbor with a tall wooden mast.

rav-tavla.name: Rav Tavla
rav-tavla.bio: Babylonian Amora who cites rulings of Rav.
rav-tavla.prompt: A sage in his 50s with a greying beard and a dark blue wool mantle, raising one finger to correct a reciter’s wording; background of a Babylonian study hall with mud-brick walls and a row of seated students.
